### 2. Custom domain unblocked and live
`chickshackg84.com` + `www` now serve the storefront. HTTP 200, Cloudflare SSL, worker `d02f7fa5`.

The blocker was two dead Vercel records occupying the hostname (`100117`). Malik deleted exactly
`A @ → 216.198.79.1` and `CNAME www → b00d3203a061e681.vercel-dns-017.com` in the dashboard; nothing
else was touched. **All seven email records verified intact afterwards** (MX, SPF, `_dmarc`, four
DKIM).

Discovered on the way: the authenticated `wrangler` token has **`zone (read)` only, no
`dns_records:edit`**, and there is no Cloudflare API token in `_context/secrets/`. DNS changes need a
human at the dashboard.

### 3. Storefront images built (Malik's request)
Every item now shows a photo. Self-hosted WebP, split into lazy 240px thumbnails (168 KB for the
whole menu) plus on-demand 720px heroes. Nine images, **each one viewed before use** rather than
trusted by filename.

Design: category image as the fallback, per-item override, and an explicit `image: null` opt-out so
Fish/Veggie items don't inherit a fried-chicken photo. Kids/Dips/Drinks render a branded monogram
tile instead of a misleading stock shot.

### 4. Notes restructured into `_state/` (Malik's request)
Replaced the 200-line monolith. Stable-named topic files with timestamps inside for current state;
date-named frozen files for history. See `_state/README.md`.

### 5. Imran's Bluetooth printer question answered

## Corrections made to my own earlier statements this session

- **I called the custom domain "live" too early.** It was live per authoritative DNS, but not
  reachable from Malik's LAN, which is what actually matters. Root cause: his **router at
  `192.168.1.1` was caching the dead `216.198.79.1`**. `ipconfig /flushdns` does not fix this — it
  clears Windows' cache, which then re-asks the router. Confirmed live from mobile data.
- **I repeated a mistaken premise about images.** `chick-shack.com` does *not* have a photo per item:
  its menu page has 2 images across ~50 items, the per-item photos are ~6 on the homepage, and **all
  of them are Unsplash stock, not the client's food.**

## Things found that nobody was looking for

- **`OrderItemCreate.unit_price` is supplied by the client.** Fine for a trusted till, **fatal on a
  public endpoint.** The public order path needs its own schema accepting IDs and quantities only.
- **`Order.created_by` is `nullable=False`** and FKs to `users`. A public order has no logged-in user.
  Needs a system user or a nullable column — decide deliberately.
- **`order_type` has no DB constraint.** It is a plain `String(20)` with a comment; the real
  constraint is a Pydantic pattern at `schemas/order.py:35`. So adding `online` needs **no migration**
  for that column. `STATE.md` implied otherwise.
- **"No bridge needed" for printing is probably wrong** — the printer sits behind the shop's NAT and
  our API is in Singapore.
